$comment: Tests known to fail intermittently, and the ONLY place that fact is recorded — Phase 42.
A flaky test is worse than a missing one: it teaches people to re-run a red build without
reading it, and the day a real failure arrives they re-run that too. So a test that flakes is
quarantined by NAME, here, where somebody has to write down what they saw and when — never by
adding a retry to the runner, which hides every flake including the ones nobody has noticed.
THE LIST IS CAPPED AT THREE. A fourth entry is not an admin problem, it is a signal that the
suite has stopped being trusted, and the response is to fix one rather than to raise the cap.
A row must carry: the test's full title, the date it was quarantined, what was observed, and
the reason it is not simply fixed. An entry with no owner and no date is deleted at the next
review, because nobody can act on it.
EMPTY TODAY, AND THAT IS A CLAIM RATHER THAN AN OMISSION: the suites in this repository have
not been observed to flake. `scripts/test/check-flaky.mjs` reads this file, so an entry that
does not match a real test title fails the build.
